Identified as this saint because: A Russian Menaion Reader plate, and both halves of the identity rule hold. The code «11022» reads church-month 11 = July, day 02, and 2 July is this folder's feast in all four calendars. The title «Ювеналий» is one of the two forms this folder's own stored Russian name carries, «Иувеналий (Ювеналий) Иерусалимский». Reached by route 2: Wikidata Q2996896 'Juvenal of Jerusalem', the bishop of Jerusalem, carries this plate as its P18, so the plate is not matched on a date alone — Wikidata attaches it to this saint. Commons files it under `Category:Saints of Jerusalem`. A single-figure plate, 578x1712, PD-old-100-expired.
